Original Liberator July5,1844 printedp107 rightmost column visually verified: brief notice identifies Rev.John Cross imprisoned at Knavishville jail for harboring enslaved children and reports he has been liberated. This proves release by publication, not release on July5 or necessarily in July. No exact or month endpoint entered.
